definitions.explanation: An army or body of troops, especially as a force on the move or in battle. Mostly used of historical warfare.

examples.japanese: {大|だい}{軍勢|ぐんぜい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{攻|せ}めて→攻める：02123_semeru⟧きた。
⟦{敵|てき}→敵：03546_teki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{軍勢|ぐんぜい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三万|さんまん}→三万：30467_sanman⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{及|およ}んだ→及ぶ：01921_oyobu⟧。
examples.english: The enemy forces numbered as many as thirty thousand.

examples.japanese: {信長|のぶなが}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧{軍勢|ぐんぜい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{今川|いまがわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{大軍|たいぐん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}った→破る：02321_yaburu⟧。
examples.english: Nobunaga defeated the large Imagawa army with a small force.

notes:
USAGE:
A word of historical writing, period dramas, and battle games. A modern army as an organization is a ⟦{軍隊|ぐんたい}→軍隊：02678_guntai⟧, and a unit is a ⟦{部隊|ぶたい}→部隊：28119_butai⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大|だい}{軍勢|ぐんぜい}: a huge army
- {軍勢|ぐんぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{率|ひき}いる→率いる：10879_hikiiru⟧: to lead troops
- {軍勢|ぐんぜい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}める→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧: to raise an army

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{軍隊|ぐんたい}→軍隊：02678_guntai⟧: an army as an institution
- {大軍|たいぐん}: a large army
